_comment: CANONICAL registry of the AICOM live demo deployment on Base mainnet, and the ONLY file where a deployed address is written by hand. Every consumer is GENERATED from it by scripts/sync_deployment_addresses.py: aimarket-hub/aimarket_hub/deployments/ and alien-monitor/backend/deployments/ (Python package data, read by chain_net.py, which no longer carries an inline address table) and argus/src/ecosystem/deployments.base.json (imported by networks.ts). The addresses used to be MIRRORED into those three places by hand, so a redeploy was a six-file edit and the drift test only noticed afterwards; tests/test_base_deployment_registry.py now fails if any consumer hard-codes an address or if a generated file is stale. The human-readable record (with every deployment transaction) is docs/onchain-journal.md. Addresses are PUBLIC (on-chain, verifiable on Basescan); committing them is safe. They auto-load as the default for chain=base when AIFACTORY_CRYPTO_ENABLED=1; any AIMARKET_ADDR_BASE_<NAME> env var overrides. The payment RECIPIENT wallet is deliberately NOT defaulted here — it must be set explicitly per deployment so funds never silently route to the demo owner.

acex_redeploy_2026_08_22.reason: security audit: collateral double-pledge + self-triggerable default
acex_redeploy_2026_08_22.note: The superseded contracts held no funds (verified 0 ETH / 0 USDC before the redeploy) and are immutable, so they are abandoned rather than migrated.

escrow_lottery_redeploy_2026_09_04.reason: security audit 2026-09-04: AIMarketEscrow credited the GROSS deposit instead of the measured delta (a fee-taking or rebasing whitelisted token made the per-channel books exceed real holdings, and payouts came out of other channels' principal); AIAgentLottery derived its onchainVdf random word from the RAW caller-supplied y while ChronosVDF only ever compared y as a residue (the beacon signer could grind the winner by submitting y + k*N), and fund() accepted Status.Drawing so the unclaimed-prize roll-in cap could be raised after entries had closed.
escrow_lottery_redeploy_2026_09_04.superseded_held_funds: none — both read 0 USDC and 0 ETH immediately before the redeploy, so the old set was abandoned rather than migrated (same precedent as acex_redeploy_2026_08_22)
escrow_lottery_redeploy_2026_09_04.latent_under_current_config: Both headline fixes were LATENT on the old deployment and remain so on this one: onchainVdf is false (so the grinding path is not reachable) and only USDC is whitelisted (and USDC takes no transfer fee). The fund() window fix is live.

switchover_done.what: HORKOS (escrow-signer, escrow_signer/config.py pin) and the hub (AIMARKET_ESCROW_EVM_ADDRESS / AIMARKET_ESCROW_CONTRACT / AIFACTORY_AI_MARKET_CONTRACT in its container environment) were moved together; the hub does NOT read the escrow from this registry at runtime.
switchover_done.preconditions: superseded escrow held 0 USDC and 0 ETH; hub channels/holds/payout_obligations all 0 rows; 113 debit_authorizations all terminal; HORKOS booted with live_rows=0
switchover_done.verified: HORKOS fail-closed boot check re-derived the EIP-712 separator for the new address and matched the escrow's own domainSeparator(), confirmed the hub key in authorizedHubs, and reported ready; hub healthy, payment_configured true, 133 priced capabilities, unpaid invoke returns a well-formed 402 x402 challenge; hub reaches HORKOS over the tunnel and both report the same escrow
switchover_done.not_proven: no debit has been signed and mined against the new escrow yet — that needs a real USDC deposit to open a channel
switchover_done.rollback: docker rm modelmarket-hub && docker rename hub-rollback-20260904-091402 modelmarket-hub && docker start modelmarket-hub (the parked container keeps the original environment); HORKOS: restore escrow_signer/config.py.bak-20260904-121240 and rebuild
switchover_done.deploy_sources_patched: hub-runtime.env, hub-runargs.txt, three deploy/hub-payment.env copies and two product participant envs still named the superseded escrow; all backed up and repointed, or the next routine redeploy would have reverted the rail
